description: R3 — debugger-informed patch -> verifier. Same RAW Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, same task/budgets as R2, with fix: diagnosis RuntimeEvidence->PATCH (not self-transition), retained diagnosis + runtime slice into bounded PATCH checkpoint (patch+failed only), administrative closeout after apply, verifier authority.

interface_repairs.a_source_visibility: Production target source with line numbers and breakpoint-eligible lines shown at the break decision point.
interface_repairs.b_source_rendering: get_source_window observations render actual source lines, not just the summary string.
interface_repairs.c_error_diagnostics: Bounded/redacted ToolExecutionError diagnostics propagated and rendered in error observations.
interface_repairs.d_tool_execution_diagnostic: ToolExecutionError carries safe_diagnostic; dispatch extracts it through the existing bounded/redacted safety pipeline.
interface_repairs.e_lifecycle_visibility: Debugger lifecycle via public PdbSession.get_target_status(); exited/failed/terminated never rendered as PAUSED; fail-closed on status failure.
interface_repairs.f_r2_staging: R2 staged PAUSED progression: NOT_STARTED->break->PAUSED_NEEDS_STACK->stack->PAUSED_NEEDS_INSPECTION->locals/print->PAUSED_NEEDS_STEP->step/next->PAUSED_AFTER_STEP_NEEDS_STACK->stack->READY_FOR_DIAGNOSIS->diagnosis. Only staged-legal commands advertised/accepted.
interface_repairs.g_stage_tracking: Experiment-local, idempotent, fail-closed R2StageTracker advancing only from new verified status=ok observations.
interface_repairs.h_r3_diagnosis_to_patch: R3 fix: diagnosis in READY_FOR_DIAGNOSIS transitions RuntimeEvidence->PATCH (not self-transition). Exact text retained verbatim into bounded PATCH prompt with correlated runtime slice and provenance.
interface_repairs.i_r3_bounded_patch_checkpoint: PATCH advertises only patch+failed before successful apply. After successful APPLY_PATCH, runner performs deterministic administrative closeout without transport; verifier evaluates exact candidate.
interface_repairs.j_r3_oracle_exclusion: PATCH prompt excludes reference_repair, oracle root_cause_summary/target_symbols/runtime_evidence_hint, inspect_expressions, gold patch. Contains only task desc, source, exact diagnosis, bounded correlated observations.
interface_repairs.k_r3_truthful_checkpoint: PATCH prompt states 'Debugger interaction checkpoint complete. No further debugger commands are available in Patch phase.' — does not claim PDB session ended unless actually exited.
interface_repairs.l_r3_2_serialization_normalization: R3.2: fail-closed metadata-only hunk-count normalizer (serialization.py). B -> C recomputes ONLY old_count/new_count from hunk body (context+removed / context+added), preserving paths, starts, suffix, body lines, ordering, and \ No newline markers. Semantic/body fingerprint equality required before dispatch; PatchManager and EvaluationVerifier receive C only. A/B/C SHA-256 recorded.

treatment.forced_runtime_entry: Administrative REPRODUCE->UNDERSTAND->RUNTIME_EVIDENCE navigation after verified reproduction (reused from D1/R1/R2).
treatment.r3_staging: Same staged PAUSED progression as R2; diagnosis exits to PATCH.
treatment.r3_patch_checkpoint: Bounded patch checkpoint: patch (unified diff) + failed before apply; administrative bookkeeping after.

source_baseline.note: R3 descends from committed R2 (97cc7fe). R1/R2 evidence preserved immutably.
